problems.firstDayPast: The first day can’t be in the past
problems.firstDayFar: Pick a first day in the next 90 days
problems.pickReveal: Pick when the winners are revealed
problems.prizeNameShort: Give each prize a name of 2 characters or more
problems.prizePhotoName: Give each prize photo a name
problems.pickPartner: Pick the partner brand, or switch the partner code off
problems.partnerNoCodes: That brand has no codes to give right now. Pick another
problems.bookingHttps: A booking link starts with https://
problems.bookingEmail: A booking link can’t ask for members’ email addresses

schedule.pickFirstDay: Pick the first day to see every date.
schedule.seals: The board seals at midnight after the last day. Members can join until then.

load.title: Can’t open this event
load.notYours: Only the gym that runs this event can change it.
load.pending: It’s with POWR for a quick check. Pull it back from the event page to change it.
load.finished: This event has finished, so it can’t change. Run it again as a new event.
load.noFormat: This kind of event is no longer offered. Contact POWR to change it.

save.sentForCheck: Sent to POWR for a quick check
save.published: Published. Your members can see it now

lockedNote: It’s under way, so only the name, headline, logo, picture and booking link can change, plus the partner code, the notifications and when the winners are revealed.

format.subEdit: The format is set once an event is saved. Run it again as a new event to pick another.
format.subNew: Pick a format. You choose how long it runs, what counts and more in the next steps.
format.countsVenue: Counts sessions at {{gym}}. You can change this.
format.countsAll: Counts any verified workout. You can change this.

when.title: Name and dates
when.sub: The first day starts at midnight. Every other date follows from the choices here.
when.name: Event name

reveal.label: Revealing the winners
reveal.manualBody_one: Press Reveal from your phone or the portal. The app and your screen flip together. If nobody does, POWR reveals them about {{count}} day after the board seals.
reveal.manualBody_other: Press Reveal from your phone or the portal. The app and your screen flip together. If nobody does, POWR reveals them about {{count}} days after the board seals.
reveal.manualBodyFinale_one: Press Reveal from your phone on the finale night or the portal. The app and your screen flip together. If nobody does, POWR reveals them about {{count}} day after the board seals.
reveal.manualBodyFinale_other: Press Reveal from your phone on the finale night or the portal. The app and your screen flip together. If nobody does, POWR reveals them about {{count}} days after the board seals.
reveal.atBody: Pick a time after the board seals and within a week of it.

scoring.title: What counts
scoring.sub: Members score points for verified activity. Choose which activity moves this board.
scoring.allBody: Anything members do, anywhere: gym check-ins, and workouts from their watch or phone.
scoring.venueBody: Members check in with POWR when they arrive. The hardest to game, and footfall you can see.
scoring.pickBody: Choose what counts, like running and cycling for a run club.
scoring.walkingNote: Walking includes everyone’s daily steps, so it can outweigh workouts.
scoring.manualNote: Workouts typed in by hand never count. POWR checks everything else.
scoring.boardHint: How many places show on the board in the app and on your screen.
scoring.bonusHint: {{blurb}} POWR pays it to members who joined and check in at {{gym}} on the night.
scoring.rulesWritten: Written for you from your choices
scoring.rulesPick: Pick an activity to see them.
scoring.addRule: Add a rule of your own

prizes.sub: 1st place first. You give these out: winners show their POWR ID at the front desk.
prizes.photosNote: Photos show with the prizes in the app, on the share page and on your screen. Buying prizes? <partners><gold>Your partner discounts</gold></partners> get you the price POWR members pay.

partner.title: A partner code for everyone who takes part
partner.body: When you reveal the winners, everyone who scored gets a discount code from the POWR partner you pick. It lands in their Wallet in the app.
partner.loadFailed: The partner brands couldn’t load just now.
partner.none: No partner has codes to give right now.
partner.note: One each, for everyone still in the event with points. If the codes run short, the top of the board get theirs first. Say so in your headline, so members know it’s coming.

announce.title: Announcement
announce.detail: To your members and recent visitors who haven’t joined. Once, in the daytime, after you publish.

kickoff.title: Day one
kickoff.detail: To everyone who’s joined, the morning scoring starts.

doors.title: Finale night
doors.detail: To everyone who’s joined, the morning of the finale.

promote.title: Promote it
promote.sub: How it looks, who sees it, and the notifications POWR sends for you.
promote.logoHint: Shown on the event’s card in the app. A wide logo on a transparent background works best.
promote.logoOnly: Show the logo instead of the name
promote.headline: Headline
promote.headlineHint: One line under the name, in the app and on share cards.
promote.headlinePlaceholder: Most sessions in October wins a free month
promote.mediaHint: The big picture on the event’s card in the app and on share cards. A short video plays silently.
promote.bookingHint: If members book a place on your own system, link it here and the app shows a Book button. {name} fills in their name.
promote.audience: Who sees it in the app
promote.audienceHint: Your members and anyone who’s trained at {{gym}} lately always see it. Anyone can join from your QR code or link.
promote.notificationsHint: POWR writes every word and sends them at the right moment. Nothing goes out until the event is published, and members can turn notifications off.
promote.standingsBody: Each member’s own rank and points, and how far they are from the place above. Only while the board is live.

review.title: Check it over
review.subEdit: Save to update it everywhere it shows.
review.subNew: Nothing goes out until you publish. You can save it as a draft and come back.
review.finaleBonus: +{{points}} POWR for coming to the finale night
review.partnerCode: Plus a {{brand}} code for everyone who scores, in their Wallet at the reveal
review.audienceKm: Your members, recent visitors and anyone within {{km}} km

publish.trusted: Publishing puts it in front of your members straight away.
publish.check: Your first event gets a quick check from POWR before it goes out, usually within a day.
